class.name: WeatherEffect
class.brief_description: One part of the weather, run by a [Weather] node.
class.description:
Base class of the weather's effects: lighting, sky, rain, haze, lightning, sound. A [Weather] node runs the effects in its [member Weather.effects] list. A new kind of effect (snow, hail, sand) is a new subclass, in C++ or a script: [method _start] creates its nodes (as internal children of the [Weather] node), [method _update] follows the weather every frame, [method _stop] frees them, and [method _apply_quality] adapts to the quality level. Scene values an effect changes should go through [method Weather.drive], so they are restored before the scene is saved. Effects keep per-scene state, so they are local to the scene. [codeblock] class_name SnowEffect extends WeatherEffect
func _update(weather: Weather, delta: float) -> void: var snow: float = weather.get_current().get(&"snow") if &"snow" in weather.get_current() else 0.0 # Show snow particles at this amount, drift them with weather.get_wind()... [/codeblock]

method.name: _apply_quality
method.description: Called before [method _start] and when the quality level changes. [param quality] is a [enum Weather.Quality] other than [constant Weather.QUALITY_AUTO].

method.name: _start
method.description: Called when the effect starts running on [param weather]: create its nodes here.

method.name: _stop
method.description: Called when the effect stops (removed, disabled, or the [Weather] node leaves the tree): free its nodes here.

method.name: _update
method.description: Called every frame while the effect runs, after the weather has blended and driven the wind.

members.member: If [code]false[/code], the effect stops and doesn't run.
